jobs.description:
Xplor Technologies powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership-based and service-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences.

Job Description

About the opportunity

Join our Embedded Payments team as a Full Stack Software Engineer and make a real impact every day. We say that because we know that every conversation we have, every line of code we write, and every interface we design is another opportunity for us to elevate everyday life experiences for our customers and the people and communities they serve.

Reporting to the Software Engineering Manager, you'll help build and scale our cloud-native payment orchestration platform that processes significant transaction volume across multiple Xplor brands.

You are passionate about building scalable systems and great user experiences while maintaining software development best practices. You write code that is thoughtful end-to-end — from the API contract down to the database, and from the data model up through the UI. You're comfortable owning features across the stack and collaborating closely with backend, frontend, QA, and DevOps engineers to deliver high-quality software.

Our Tech Stack

Frontend: React (Vite), MUI, JavaScript
Testing: Jest, ESLint, Prettier, Storybook, Playwright, K6
Backend: Node.js, AWS (ECS, RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, API Gateway, Lambda, Cognito, SQS, EventBridge)
DevOps: Bitbucket Pipelines, Terraform
Payments: Worldpay, Stripe, Apple Pay / Google Pay

Execute the full software development lifecycle across both backend services and frontend interfaces
Design and build well-tested, well-documented features that span APIs, data models, and UI
Produce technical specifications and assess operational feasibility for new payments features
Integrate components into cohesive, production-ready systems with appropriate observability
Contribute to verification plans, quality assurance procedures, and deployment guardrails
Maintain and improve existing functionality, including documentation
Participate in deployment planning, on-call rotations, and incident response as part of running a payments platform
Use AI-assisted development tools effectively to improve velocity without compromising quality
Stay current with platform updates, security practices, and PCI compliance requirements

Qualifications

What would make you a good candidate?

We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big-picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do.

You'll need:

4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a Computer Science/Engineering degree or equivalent
Strong Node.js experience and demonstrated ability to ship production backend services
Experience building React-based frontends that consume RESTful APIs
Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and microservices
Working knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and clear understanding of separation of concerns in service design
Hands-on experience with AWS or a comparable cloud platform
Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, or similar)
Proficiency with Git, agile delivery (Scrum preferred), and testing frameworks like Jest
Fluency with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) and an articulate point of view on where they help and where they don't
Comfortable working on a 100% remote team and able to operate independently within an agile group

It would be great if you also have:

Experience building or operating payments systems — payment orchestration, tokenization, acquirer integrations (Worldpay, Stripe, Adyen, Finix, Basis Theory), or PCI-compliant environments
Familiarity with event-driven architectures (SQS, EventBridge, Kafka)
Exposure to observability tooling (SigNoz, Grafana, Datadog, etc.)
Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform)

At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences - people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you do not tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Fully remote option, U.S.-based (excluding Hawaii and Alaska). Preference for candidates in the Kansas City region

Values and Life at Xplor

Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day:

Find a better way
Do the right thing
Say it straight
Win together
Own the outcome

If these values sound like you, and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor.

The Storage organization builds and operates the online stateful systems and abstractions that DoorDash Engineering depends on: reliable, efficient, secure, and easy to use.
